## 2025-02-18 - [Fixing Static Validation for Dynamic UI]
**Learning:** The `tests/test_flow_studio_ui_ids.py` test suite validates UIIDs by parsing static HTML generated by `make gen-index-html`. Elements rendered dynamically via JavaScript (like the Run Detail modal's re-run button) are not present in the static HTML, causing tests to fail if they expect those IDs.
**Action:** When adding or modifying dynamically rendered elements that are checked by static validation tests, add a hidden placeholder element with the correct `data-uiid` and `aria-hidden="true"` to the corresponding HTML fragment (e.g., `swarm/tools/flow_studio_ui/fragments/60-modals.html`). This satisfies the static check without affecting the runtime UI.
